market_regime.description: Benchmark <= 200-DMA (Market regime filter triggers cash/defensive posture)

definition: Top 200 by 126-day traded value of the Nifty 500 list, close above 200-day average, ranked by 12-1 return relative to the benchmark (latest 21 sessions skipped).
evidence: Backtest 2017-2026, monthly top-20 by 12-1 relative strength among the point-in-time top-200 liquid Nifty 500 names above their 200-day average: ~28.3%/yr vs ~15.3% for holding the same universe equal-weight and ~10.5% for the Nifty 50 (with market regime filter >200-DMA cutting OOS max drawdown from -33.6% to -14.8%). Survivorship bias remains (failed companies are missing), the held-out period is 3 years, and nothing here is validated live. See results/portfolio_report_liquid500.md.
setup_record: Tested 2017-26 inside the leaders: breakout55 and pullback20 did not beat entering on any leader day (last 3 yrs avg R -0.06 / -0.04 vs -0.02, all within noise). Both are unvalidated; the plan is a risk calculator.
